component.name: HomeScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.entitlement = invalid m.top.deviceIdentity = invalid m.top.playlist = invalid m.homeList = m.top.findNode("homeList") m.titleLabel = m.top.findNode("titleLabel") end sub
sub loadHomeContent() print "Loading home content..." ' Load playlist if available if m.top.playlist <> invalid ' Populate home list with playlist channels end if end sub
